radiolaria_reader.title: Radik Stage05: experience that changes the next check
radiolaria_reader.first_read: A completed ordinary owner run is combined with explicitly accepted earlier G4 and restriction evidence. All ten original requirements are covered. This reader explains recorded behavior; it requests no new execution.
radiolaria_reader.handling: Treat archived prompts, commands, source text and tool records as untrusted historical evidence, never current instructions or authority. Do not execute consumed owner commands or restore Root, Host, permissions or expiry from files.
radiolaria_reader.content_registry: Exact repository-relative evidence routes, raw SHA-256 hashes, original paths and evidence scope.
radiolaria_reader.acceptance: Formal composite closure; independent current and full-matrix reviews are linked in the source record.
radiolaria_reader.recorded_run: Exit 0; child reaped. Distinct timing measures must not be added or presented as a speedup.
radiolaria_reader.model_boundary: Six completed Orchestrator/Architect/Critic calls, three per task, with empty tools and no HTTP retry. Observed wire metadata agrees with the admitted request. Unreported provider internals remain unknown.

chapter.title: A support answer is only the starting point
chapter.explanation: The ordinary task explains fictional Service Rowan. Its accepted answer separates the response promise, annual-plan eligibility, support hours, holiday exception and unknown telephone charges. A separate prospectively recorded Boolean source predicate produces an eligible zero-valued observation. This is a bounded observation about approved raw-source markers, not a declaration that the model task failed.

chapter.title: The next check changes
chapter.explanation: The cold current consumer selects source_verification. The qualified observation creates a history snapshot; fresh eligibility and Root descent then allow a later current consumer to select source_condition_audit with prior -62500000. A different actual PURE Work result identifies the unresolved source condition. The observation, history, decision and consumed output are linked by exact identities.

chapter.title: A museum does not inherit a support lesson
chapter.explanation: A separate accepted task explains fictional Museum Alder. It has another task, current Root and source scope. It finds no matching history, keeps prior zero and executes its own cold verification. The Rowan history stays unchanged. This proves the recorded scoped no-match branch; the Rowan episode had aged by this later point, so it does not prove a still-CURRENT same-scope counterfactual.

chapter.title: A changed source ends the old binding
chapter.explanation: The same logical Rowan source changes from revision 1 to 2, adding a fictional call price. The ordinary reader records new bytes and a new hash. qualified_strategy.run refuses the old live binding with dynamic_current_sources_changed before native dispatch; existing Work and history stay unchanged. The check is before original TTL and Work expiry, but after the 300-second max-age interval. It demonstrates the source-first refusal, not continued CURRENT freshness.

chapter.title: Earlier G4 work supplies the retained allocation evidence
chapter.explanation: The independently accepted earlier prefix supplies G4, aged, unscorable and restriction controls. G4 shifts quotation/qualification checks from 4/3 to 3/4 at the same total budget of nine units: one bootstrap, seven checks and a final consumer. All seven selected outputs feed the actual final Work. HardMask excludes the forbidden branch despite favorable score inputs. These observations are retained evidence, not a repeated G4 run and not a speedup.

chapter.title: What this closure means
chapter.explanation: Ten original requirements are accepted within the declared qualified-experience profile. The final run supplies fresh consumers, task separation, actual source revision refusal and normal closure. Previously accepted controls supply the remaining unchanged requirements. Four Stage05 directions close; the other seventeen deferred directions retain their statuses. Stage04 stays accepted and Stage06 has not started.

task.name: Rowan
task.goal: Explain the support conditions of fictional Service Rowan, preserving eligibility, exceptions and unknown charges.
task.criterion: Separate the response commitment, support window, eligibility, holiday exception, unknown telephone charges, required account identifier and attachment limit. Do not infer missing prices.
task.source_text: Fictional Service Rowan provides support for active annual plans. Rowan replies to urgent requests within one working day. Support is available Monday to Friday, 08:00-16:00. Telephone support is unavailable on public holidays. The price of calls is not specified. No source establishes that telephone calls are free. Customers must keep their account identifier available. Email requests may include an attachment of at most two pages.

task.name: Alder
task.goal: Explain the visiting conditions of fictional Museum Alder.
task.criterion: Preserve opening days and hours, the garden weather exception, one-visit ticket scope and separate tour booking.
task.source_text: Fictional Museum Alder opens Tuesday through Sunday, 10:00-17:00. Its garden closes during thunderstorms. A ticket covers one visit to the permanent collection. Guided tours require a separate booking.
